claim: Tesla expects to deliver 2.2 million vehicles in 2026.
summary: As of the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, there is no established official Tesla guidance, filing, or earnings call statement that Tesla expects to deliver 2.2 million vehicles in calendar year 2026. Tesla had withdrawn its prior 50% CAGR long-term guidance and had not yet provided numerical 2026 guidance by that date (Q4 2025 earnings call had not yet occurred), and a 2.2 million figure, if cited elsewhere, reflects analyst consensus estimates, not a stated company expectation.

sub_claims.text: Tesla has issued a formal forward expectation or guidance for vehicle deliveries
sub_claims.note: As of 2026-01-04 Tesla had withdrawn prior long-term numerical guidance and provided only qualitative commentary about being between growth waves and returning to growth; no official numerical guidance document for future deliveries is established.

sub_claims.text: The guided expected volume is 2.2 million vehicles
sub_claims.note: No Tesla press release, 10-K, or earnings transcript as of the cutoff establishes 2.2 million as a company-stated expectation; this figure aligns with external analyst consensus ranges for 2026 but is not attributable to Tesla itself.

sub_claims.text: The guidance period for the expectation is calendar year 2026
sub_claims.note: As of 2026-01-04 Tesla had not yet held its Q4 2025 earnings call where a 2026 outlook would typically be discussed, and had not published an official 2026 delivery outlook, so a company expectation specifically for full-year 2026 is not established.
